coverage_claim: A source-grounded reviewable draft of an administrative area across ISO 3166 and ISO 19112, UN M49 and SALB, INSPIRE Administrative Units, NUTS, OGC GeoSPARQL and GML, GeoJSON and RFC 3339, without universal sovereignty, jurisdictional legal-effect or certified crosswalk claims.

boundary_decision.status: accepted as a governed administrative or official statistical territorial unit
boundary_decision.rationale: The unit owns register-qualified identity, codes, names, class, authority links, hierarchy, boundary assertions and lifecycle. Governments, jurisdictions, places, zones, parcels, statistics and disputes remain external masters.

decisions.rationale: Names, ISO or statistical codes, parent, government and geometry are mutable or purpose-specific and cannot replace the authoritative identifier.
The area is territorial; a government is an organization and jurisdiction is a competence relation whose extent and time may differ.
Administrative parentage, geometric containment, statistical grouping and governmental competence can diverge and must not be inferred from one another.
Official, statistical, claimed, disputed and de facto extents remain separately attributable by authority, recognition audience and time.
Every code and name pins scheme or language, issuer, edition and validity and preserves deprecated-to-successor mappings.
Splits, mergers, transfers, annexations, renaming, recoding and reclassification record whether identity persists and preserve predecessor history.
The model records claimant, recognizing party, scope, basis and disputed extent but cannot decide universally valid sovereignty.
ISO, UN, European and OGC schemes serve different purposes, so each mapping pins versions and discloses hierarchy, geometry, recognition and round-trip loss.
The approved relation ledger contains no WM-PLC-004 rows, so proposed links to governments, jurisdictions, places, zones, parcels, statistics and disputes remain draft.

publication_holds: Claude and Grok timed out during their bounded attempts, so independent external review is absent and explicitly waived for this published reviewable draft.
The approved relationship ledger contains no WM-PLC-004 rows, so all proposed sibling composition remains draft.
Jurisdiction-specific local-government law, sovereignty, indigenous and customary territory, maritime, historical and conflict-sensitive profiles require specialist review.
Certified ISO 3166, ISO 19112, M49, SALB, INSPIRE, NUTS, GML, GeoSPARQL and GeoJSON crosswalks and conformance fixtures remain unverified.
deferred_research: Approve identifiers and relation cardinalities for government, jurisdiction, place, address, zone, parcel, statistic and dispute models.
Develop jurisdiction, historical, maritime, indigenous, customary, occupied and conflict-sensitive administrative-area profiles.
Create fixtures for hierarchy cycles, wrong code editions, multilingual renaming, enclaves, exclaves, disputed boundaries, split, merger and retroactive effect.
Validate certified code, hierarchy and geometry projections with recognition, CRS, topology, loss and round-trip tests.
